annotations.title: TIA — IO systems of the project

description: Lists every IO system of the project: {name, number, subnet, controller {device, interface} or null, devices [{device, interface}]}, plus `inventoryGaps` [{kind, subject, reason}] (reads that failed during the scan; empty when all succeeded, otherwise the list may be incomplete; a gap of kind `io_system_subnet` also carries `ioSystem` {number, controller}, the identity the serve decides on, while `subject` is only the name). Pass limit (1..1000) and each nextCursor as cursor to page IO-device assignments; an empty system is one unit. A split system repeats its header with only that page's devices, and total counts assignments plus empty systems. inventoryGaps describes the whole scan. If inventoryGaps itself is omitted, a smaller limit cannot shrink it: raise TIA_MCP_MAX_VALUE_CHARS/TIA_MCP_MAX_RESPONSE_CHARS or read the serve directly. Restart without cursor on cursor_stale. Requires a connected project. Maps to GET /iosystems. Read-only (class R).

cursor.description: opaque nextCursor of the previous intact page; omit for the first page

limit.description: page size, 1..1000 IO-assignment or empty-system units
